title: Practice 11: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: The bricklayer is building a wall.
exercises.why: **возводить → возводит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: They abstain from alcohol.
exercises.why: **воздерживаться → воздерживаются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The weather forecast says we're in for heavy rain this evening.
exercises.why: **обещать → обещают** — present-type form, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Тома ___ (раздражать), когда Маша не закручивает колпачок зубной пасты.
exercises.prompt: It irritates Tom when Mary leaves the cap off the toothpaste.
exercises.why: **раздражать → раздражает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: There's no response from the moon base.
exercises.why: **отвечать → отвечает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Knock before you open the door.
exercises.why: **входить → входите** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ите belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Исса ___ (путешествовать) по миру в поисках приключений.
exercises.prompt: Issa travels the world in search of adventure.
exercises.why: **путешествовать → путешествует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: She reads Chinese.
exercises.why: **читать → читает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I'm not interested in material gain.
exercises.why: **интересовать → интересует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom is contributing.
exercises.why: **вносить → вносит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The art teacher paints at night.
exercises.why: **рисовать → рисует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Том ___ (раздражаться), ведь он всегда должен выбирать свой путь.
exercises.prompt: Tom is irritating because he always has to have his own way.
exercises.why: **раздражаться → раздражается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: They're always fighting.
exercises.why: **ругаться → ругаются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: My grandfather raises ducks.
exercises.why: **разводить → разводит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: My name is Edgar Degas.
exercises.why: **звать → зовут** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Wet clothes adhere to the skin.
exercises.why: **прилипать → прилипает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Mud clings to my shoes.
exercises.why: **липнуть → липнет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Elderly people accumulate quirks.
exercises.why: **обрастать → обрастают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: You have a very logical way of thinking.
exercises.why: **мыслить → мыслишь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ишь belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Вы ___ (собираться) возобновить договор об аренде по его истечении?
exercises.prompt: Are you going to renew your lease when it expires?
exercises.why: **собираться → собираетесь** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
